components.html: <form class="ds-search"><label class="ds-search-label" for="ds-q">Search agents</label><input id="ds-q" placeholder="Search by agent, ERC-8004 ID, address, capability or protocol"><button aria-label="Search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg></button></form>
components.css: .ds-search { max-width: 880px; min-height: 58px; display: flex; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.28); } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px; padding: 15px 19px; color: #16293d; font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 550; outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #66788a; opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,169,232,.28), 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.28); } .ds-search button { width: 44px; min-width: 44px; height: 44px; margin: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #009ed7; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search button:hover { background: #007eae; } .ds-search button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(184,243,74,.55); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search svg { width: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #dce4e9; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 7px 22px rgba(10,35,55,.055); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-panel header { min-height: 62px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 17px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.15px; } .ds-panel a { color: #377086; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-panel a:hover { color: var(--link); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-panel a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,169,232,.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-panel-row { min-height: 78px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 13px 19px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-panel-icon { width: 39px; height: 39px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #d8e5ea; border-radius: 50%; background: #f4f8fa; color: #0a8fc2; font-weight: 800; } .ds-panel strong, .ds-panel small { display: block; } .ds-panel strong { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-panel small, .ds-panel time { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-panel-footer { display: block; padding: 14px; background: #f8fafb; text-align: center; }

components.css: .ds-category { min-height: 82px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #dce4e9; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-category:hover { border-color: #91d5eb; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(7,60,84,.08); } .ds-category:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,169,232,.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-category:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-category-glyph { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid #cae9f3; border-radius: 50%; background: #effafe; } .ds-category-glyph:before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 13px; height: 13px; left: 10px; top: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--link); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-category-glyph:after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 4px; height: 4px; right: 7px; top: 7px; border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal); } .ds-category strong, .ds-category small { display: block; } .ds-category strong { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-category small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 550; } .ds-category svg { width: 16px; fill: none; stroke: var(--link); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

narrative.overview:
AgentDB is an Operate-mode explorer: serious, compact, and evidence-first. Its visual world pairs a dark navy live-signal field with crisp white registry surfaces, making onchain records feel active without turning the interface into a trading dashboard. Cyan marks navigation and inspectable evidence; acid lime is reserved for live or verified signal moments.

The structure inherits the useful density of a block explorer, but its identity comes from sonar rings, telemetry traces, compact signal glyphs, and a database-node mark. The Etherscan reference informs information architecture only. The implemented system does not copy its brand, palette, or visual mannerisms.
keyCharacteristics: High-density evidence surfaces on a cool, quiet canvas.
Dark navy live-signal fields paired with crisp white registry cards.
Cyan for navigation and inspectable evidence; acid lime for rare live or verification signals.
Locally bundled Manrope Variable, used at weights 500–800 for legibility and authority.
Sonar, telemetry, and node geometry expressed through CSS and inline SVG.
One restrained pulse with a reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Acid lime marks an actual live or verification cue; it is never a general-purpose fill, link color, or decorative wash.

rules.name: The Evidence Contrast Rule
rules.body: Dense records live on white or near-white surfaces with dark ink; navy is reserved for framing, orientation, and the live-signal hero.

rules.name: The Compact Authority Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with weight, tracking, and surface placement before increasing type size.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Density Rule
rules.body: Keep rows and cards compact enough to compare records, but preserve clear group boundaries and stable alignment for names, metadata, status, and timestamps.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows explain stacking or interaction; they do not decorate every container.

rules.name: The Semantic Geometry Rule
rules.body: Circles mean agents, nodes, or live signal; rounded rectangles mean tasks, controls, or bounded evidence.

dos: Do present real agent, registration, task, network, and verification data; use explicit unavailable and empty states when evidence is absent.
Do use cyan for inspectable evidence and acid lime only for a live or verified signal.
Do keep shared screens inside the 1240px container and preserve compact, aligned evidence rows.
Do use the locally bundled Manrope Variable family at weights 500–800.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior for the single signal pulse.
donts: Don't fabricate counts, prices, task history, hireability, or trust claims to make a surface feel complete.
Don't turn the interface into a neon trading terminal or cover white evidence surfaces with dark panels.
Don't add additional looping animations, ambient particle fields, or competing pulses.
Don't copy Etherscan's brand identity; use it only as structural evidence for explorer density and information architecture.
Don't substitute generic icon-library glyphs for the established database-node, sonar, activity, task, and arrow grammar.
